changeStatus: ONE code change in window (story-027 bb4fea0): stake() gains `require(poolState == PoolState.Active)` (audit-20 M-05 / bdf84579 gate). Verified via git diff: no other code changes.

intendedDeltasVsPriceScaled: Freeze hooks: _updatePool no-op while Migrating; pendingReward/totalDebt frozen while Migrating

PRICE-SCALED-SPECIFIC: accrual-path recomputes routed through _recomputeScheduleIfActive (rate depends on totalStaked, so the frozen snapshot must be pinned); depositFor tail _recomputeSchedule is LOAD-BEARING; finalizeAndReset DOES recompute (unlike depletion variants)
cloneRelationship.keyDifferenceVsDepletionFamily: rate = S*targetAPY/SECONDS_PER_YEAR with S = totalStaked * latestPrice * priceScale -- rate DEPENDS on totalStaked and dispatcher price; priceScale (immutable, e.g. 1e12 for 6dp USDC prime token) normalizes price into phUSD units (run-17 L-08 magnitude footgun)

verifiedProperties.checkedArithmetic: verified (0.8.20; mulDiv floor paths; documented overflow bound totalStaked*latestPrice*priceScale < 2^256 for priceScale <= 1e12)
verifiedProperties.depositForSettlement: CONFORMING: pays pre-existing pending via _safePayTo(user, ...) (line ~901) -- migrators' capture-and-forward self-disables against this contract
verifiedProperties.migrationFreeze: verified and STRONGER than depletion family: _recomputeScheduleIfActive pins rate/windowEnd/rewardBudget while Migrating on ALL accrual-path recomputes (user unstake-while-Migrating cannot move the snapshot); finalizeAndReset flips Active FIRST then recomputes (S==0 -> rate 0, mirrors unstake-to-zero)
verifiedProperties.targetAPYBound: targetAPY <= 0.5e18 (MAX_TARGET_APY); settles at OLD rate before mutation

localFindings.description: Story-027 gate audit: stake() now requires Active; unstake/claim deliberately ungated (unstake is the totalStaked drain path to finalizeAndReset; both settle against frozen accRewardPerShare and their tail recomputes are suppressed by _recomputeScheduleIfActive, so they cannot disturb the snapshot). claim-while-Migrating pays the frozen pending early but identically to what _exitPosition would settle -- no over/under-payment identified locally. Gate is faithful to the M-05 intent.

Carries priceScale magnitude footgun (run-17 L-08, immutable ctor arg -- wrong power of ten silently mis-scales APY) and the emergencyWithdraw no-recompute survivor over-emission class. Both known/triaged on ancestors; listed for drift-watch continuity. Fork-drift watch-note now spans THREE hand-maintained clones.

interfaceAbstraction.note: Entry-point surface identical in shape to NFTStakerDepletionV2.profile.json with these deltas: constructor takes extra immutable priceScale (!=0); setTargetAPY replaces setDepletionWindow; _syncBudget recompute is UNCONDITIONAL but Active-guarded; stake/unstake carry tail _recomputeScheduleIfActive; depositFor tail recompute unconditional (requires Active anyway); finalizeAndReset recomputes.
